subject: How to access browser session/cookies from within Shiny App?

messages.author: 433c997c93cf1199
messages.subject: How to access browser session/cookies from within Shiny App?
parts:
Hi everyone!

I have a quick question: How can I access cookies and other browser-related session data from within a Shiny app?

I know there is session$clientData (http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/client-data.html) but this seems to be limited to only a few data points. Is there a specific "Shiny way" of doing this or would I have to resort to some embedded JavaScript code? Does anyone have some sample code you could share?

Thanks so much in advance! Best regards,

Ignacio
